# Themes

The biggest part of JCORE has always been the theme. There has been 3 major versions so far. They have all had slightly different focus.

## JCORE 1

This was a block theme built on the Advanced Custom Fields plugin and Timber. It used repeater fields and custom blocks to build content.

## JCORE 2

This version was based on Gutenberg as the content editor, but still used custom blocks, mostly built on ACF, but some native as well. It used Timber templates for scaffolding.

## JCORE 3

This is the current version. It uses a modular design, with composer modules and plugins, and a more minimal theme. The first iteration of JCORE 3 still used Timber templates for scaffolding, but the current one uses "Full Site Editing", with Gutenberg templates.

## Branch naming

The "versions" of JCORE has always used branch naming, but the older ones had very random names. During the midpoint of JCORE 2 we moved to an alphabetical naming scheme, and used coctails as the theme.

The first JCORE 3 theme used a paralel `G` based name, because of a possible paralell development, but there has been no new JCORE 2 after `grasshopper`.

### JCORE 2 branches

- _aviation_
- _bellini_
- _cosmopolitan_
- _daiquiri_
- _elduelo_
- _fluffycritter_
- **grasshopper**

### JCORE 3 branches

- _gintonic_
- **hurricane**
